verdict.rationale: RevenueCat ships several first-party natural-language surfaces. Rico answers plain-language questions about subscription metrics. Paywalls can be generated and edited from an AI prompt. The official MCP server lets AI assistants manage apps, Products and Entitlements without the dashboard. However, Rico is documented only for analytics Q&A, and broad configuration by natural language requires an external AI assistant connected through MCP. missing for 10: a documented in-product natural-language command interface for actions beyond analytics and paywalls, depth documentation of which operations work by NL, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: you can ask Rico plain-language questions like "Why did MRR drop in Germany last week?" and get a direct, data-driven answer
The RevenueCat MCP (Model Context Protocol) server enables AI assistants to manage subscription apps, Products, Entitlements, and everything in-between without using the RevenueCat dashboard.
Launch faster with fully customizable Paywalls that start from a template, AI-prompt or  a blank canvass.
